source_text: Stet sol super Gabaon et luna super vallem Aialon — dies longior. Heretici calumniantur; nos virtutem Dei confitemur qui elementis imperat. Sol iustitiae nobiscum in bello spiritali non occidit.
pass_a_gloss: Let-stand sun over Gibeon and moon over valley Aijalon — day longer. Heretics slander; we power of-God confess who to-elements commands. Sun of-righteousness with-us in war spiritual not sets.
pass_b_english: [[Sun, stand over Gibeon, and moon over the valley of Aijalon >> Bible:Joshua 10:12]] — a longer day. Heretics carp; we confess God’s power over the elements. The [[sun of righteousness >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]] does not set while we fight the spiritual war.
